answer_html:
Definition

The javax.servlet.http package contains classes and interfaces for writing servlets that work with the HTTP protocol.

TypeUse / key methods
HttpServlet (class)doGet(), doPost(), doPut(), doDelete()
HttpServletRequestgetParameter(), getHeader(), getCookies(), getSession(), getMethod()
HttpServletResponsesetContentType(), addCookie(), sendRedirect(), setStatus()
HttpSessionsetAttribute(), getAttribute(), invalidate()
Cookie (class)getName(), getValue(), setMaxAge()
HttpSessionListenerSession created/destroyed events
